prompt.text: can we build a rev2 of the board where all of wiznet module exept the poe module are on the carry board

quotes: can we build a rev2 of the board where all of wiznet module exept the poe module are on the carry board
2 if you can and you are allow to change the board design and size

reproduce.rule: same function on one board; the WIZPoE-P1 stays a plug-in module; mains, sensor and button circuits carried over from rev1

inputs.name: PoE
inputs.why: IEEE 802.3af PD via WIZPoE-P1 (module input 41-61 V per WIZnet), 5 V / 8 W out

inputs.name: VBUS
inputs.why: USB-C, for the serial menu and flashing; powers the board without PoE (as on the Pico)

inputs.name: AC_L/AC_N
inputs.why: mains presence sense only, ~1.2 mA, rev1 circuit unchanged

outputs.name: +3V3
outputs.why: RP2040 ~30 mA + W5500 ~132 mA max + flash, LEDs, TMP1075; 0.3 A design margin

interfaces.firmware: unchanged: Arduino-Pico 'pico' board; W5500 SPI0 GP16 MISO, GP17 CS, GP18 SCK, GP19 MOSI, GP20 RST, GP21 INT; GP27 MAINS_OK; GP22 factory reset; GP4/GP5 I2C0 TMP1075 0x48; GP25 status LED; GP24 VBUS sense, GP29 VSYS/3 as on the Pico
connectors: RJ45 10/100 with magnetics and PoE centre taps to WIZPoE-P1

isolation.why: rev1 rules (.kicad_dru), reinforced-style spacing for 230 VAC to SELV

formFactor.why: product board in an enclosure, not an Adom molecule

assumptions.what: WIZPoE-P1 fitted by hand on 1x4 sockets, not in the JLCPCB BOM
USB VBUS and PoE 5 V OR-ed with Schottky diodes into VSYS, as on the Pico
Desktop for KiCad: PIT-HomePC-KFJ (this PC, where the project lives)
